AI Overview

AI Mode replied:

E-commerce SEO is the practice of optimizing your online store so it ranks higher in search engine results and drives free, organic traffic. 
Core Components
  • Keyword Research: Find what terms shoppers use, focusing on product names, categories, and high-intent buying phrases like "buy organic coffee". 
  • Site Architecture: Build a clean, logical menu and URL structure so search engines and users can easily find every category and product. 
  • On-Page Optimization: Write unique product and category descriptions, and use targeted keywords in your page titles and headers. 
  • Technical SEO: Improve mobile friendliness, fix broken links, and increase page loading speed. 
  • Structured Data (Schema): Add behind-the-scenes code to help search engines display product prices, stock status, and reviews directly in search results. 
  • Content Marketing: Publish helpful blog posts or buying guides to attract early-stage shoppers and build site authority. 
If you want, tell me:
  • What platform is your store built on (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento)?
  • Are you struggling more with getting traffic or converting visitors?
I can give you a step-by-step plan for your shop.
